status: CONFIRMED by the user on 2026-10-21 (draft v2 plus the clarifications below); confirmation users stay sealed
question: on new KuaiRand users (27K development partition), does the best tuned personalized feature model beat tuned time-decay iALS on random exposures?
evidence_role: development evidence; tune-group random labels select every hyperparameter; report group viewed once after all choices are frozen; confirmation users stay sealed

models.LR-L1: logistic regression on L1 features (feature_model.fit_lr), l2 in {1e-4, 1e-3, 1e-2}
models.LR-L2: logistic regression on L2 features, same grid
models.Tree-L1: HistGradientBoosting on L1 numeric features + upload_type/music_type/tag1 native categorical
models.Tree-L2: HistGradientBoosting on L2 numeric features + the same categorical columns
models.tree_early_stopping: internal training control only: stratified random 10% of the 6M training rows (same users and period), log loss; not an independent or temporal generalization estimate

iALS_tuned.edge_rule: one extension at most, for the selected tau only: if selected alpha = 100 add alpha 300, if = 10 add alpha 3, each with l2 in {30,100,300} (3 fits); if selected l2 = 300 add l2 1000, if = 30 add l2 10, each with alpha in {10,30,100} (3 fits); at most 6 fits, no corner fit; then re-select over all fits with the same rule; no further extension
iALS_tuned.data: long views of all users before the cutoff (35.74M pairs, 4.49M videos); videos without a long view score 0

models.iALS_reference: frozen 1K setting tau 0.5, alpha 30, l2 100 (a grid member); reported as a reference only - beating it is not beating tuned iALS

selection.rule: every choice uses the seed-0 tune-group main-population scope-A mean per-user AUC: each family hyperparameters, and the main L2 method (selected LR-L2 vs selected Tree-L2, LR deterministic, Tree seed 0)
selection.ties: within 0.0005 -> simpler: LR larger l2; Tree fewer leaves, then larger min_samples_leaf, then larger l2_regularization; iALS larger l2, then smaller alpha, then tau 0.5; main method LR-L2
selection.after_selection: extra seeds estimate mean performance and training variability only; they never change any selection

seeds_and_aggregation.rule: repeated-run statistic, not an ensemble: for each user the per-user AUC is computed separately for every seed and averaged over seeds; the bootstrap resamples users of these seed-averaged values
seeds_and_aggregation.tuning: every grid configuration of Tree and iALS uses seed 0 only; LR is deterministic
seeds_and_aggregation.final: selected Tree-L1 and Tree-L2 rerun with seeds 1, 2 (3 seeds); selected and reference iALS rerun with seeds 1-4 (5 seeds); all seeds use the same rule on tune and report groups
seeds_and_aggregation.note: fewer seeds only shorten total time; a single fit peaks at the same memory
seeds_and_aggregation.uncertainty: the user bootstrap reflects user-sampling uncertainty with seed-averaged per-user AUC; seed-to-seed variation (per-seed means) is reported separately

evaluation.rows: development users random exposures, Asia/Shanghai date of time_ms 2022-04-22..04-28, cleaned with the 1K rules; features frozen at the cutoff
evaluation.main_population: >=1 pre-cutoff standard long view AND both outcomes in the window (tune 1,612 / report 1,671 users); conclusions apply to such users only; same rule for confirmation
evaluation.scope_A: exposures of videos with >=1 pre-cutoff exposure (primary)
evaluation.cold_start: 53 users with random exposures and no pre-cutoff long view, 20 with both outcomes (report group 7); descriptive only, all models incl. iALS (constant score -> AUC 0.5, ties half)

contrasts_report_group.primary: best L2 method (chosen on tune) - tuned iALS, scope A per-user AUC
other_secondary: best L2 method - iALS reference (labelled reference)
scope B versions of the key secondary contrasts
pooled AUC by video degree group (0, 1-2, >=3 pre-cutoff long views), user-cluster bootstrap

statistics: per-user AUC (ties half); paired user bootstrap 2000 resamples seed 2026; identical users and exposures in every comparison; sample sizes with every interval
decision_rule: practically meaningful difference +0.01 per-user AUC; a contrast supports a gain when the point estimate >= 0.01 and the 95% interval excludes 0; otherwise inconclusive or no gain; only the primary contrast answers the main question

budget_from_probes.iALS: one fit 11.0 min, peak 5.4 GB, no swap-outs (tau 0.5, alpha 30, l2 100, seed 0): grid 18 + <= 6 edge + 4 tuned seeds + 4 reference seeds = <= 32 fits, about 6 h
budget_from_probes.Tree: Tree-L2 63 leaves / 100 per leaf with early stopping: 385 rounds, 3.8 min total, peak 5.6 GB incl. the 10% holdout, 11,476 swap-out pages (~0.18 GB) during the run; 0.47 s per round -> 2000 rounds at most ~16 min; 16 grid fits + 4 seed fits expected ~1.5 h, worst case ~5 h
budget_from_probes.LR: 4 models x 3 l2 at 6M rows: about 2 min each, ~25 min
budget_from_probes.memory_rule: each run serial; if a run exceeds 10 GB or shows sustained swapping, change batching or storage (not the number of seeds)

storage: iALS seed-0 factors kept until selection (~0.6 GB each), then only selected and reference factors retained
process: all runs serial; tune group used for every choice; report group computed once for the frozen set; any later change turns it into development feedback and is recorded
not_in_scope: training on random-exposure labels, rolling feature cutoff, confirmation users

resources.note: the Tree-L2 early-stopping probe had 11,476 swap-out pages (~0.18 GB); 6M without swap-outs earlier does not guarantee none for the final configuration
resources.monitoring: serial runs; swap-outs and wall time recorded per run; a run with > 1 GB swap-outs or > 2x its expected time pauses the pipeline to fix resources; small swap-outs are not failures
resources.invariant: resource problems never change the training sample on the basis of model results

report_group: evaluated once after every model and selection is fixed

resources_revision_1.approved_by_user: 2026-10-21, after incident 3, without viewing any model result
resources_revision_1.rule: swap-outs recorded, never pause alone; pause on job failure, non-finite scores/factors/objective, memory pressure critical (kern.memorystatus_vm_pressure_level = 4) for 2 minutes (job tree terminated), or wall time > 2x the baseline of the same workload (iALS 640 s; Tree seed rerun = its seed-0 configuration wall time)
resources_revision_1.unchanged: models, data, grids, seeds, selection rules; completed runs that passed finite checks are kept; runs resume from the first unfinished configuration
resources_revision_1.fallback: if pauses keep recurring after freeing memory, compress iALS indices with a separate equivalence check
